name: Camping 101: First Aid
summary: At the Lion's Pride Inn, Michelle Belle shows you how to prepare First Aid Kits for camping. You need enough First Aid skill to learn how to ready these supplies for the road ahead.

sections.title: Field Medicine on the Road
sections.body: Travel through Elwynn can leave you wounded, far from a town healer or inn. First Aid lets you tend your own injuries without relying on anyone else. Bandages help with bleeding and trauma, without arcane rites or holy prayers.

sections.title: Supplies for the Campsite
sections.body: At Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, Michelle Belle teaches skilled practitioners to assemble First Aid Kits. Keep medical supplies at camp so a weary party can treat injuries and regain strength before facing the dangers ahead.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Adventurers with basic First Aid seek Michelle Belle in Goldshire. She teaches them to make a First Aid Kit and stock a wilderness camp with medical supplies.

faq.q: Who do I need to speak with in Goldshire?
faq.answer: Speak with Michelle Belle, a First Aid trainer in Goldshire. Once you show enough skill, she teaches you how to make camping supplies for field medicine.

faq.q: Why is First Aid important for travelers?
faq.answer: First Aid helps travelers tend injuries from beasts, bandits, and harsh weather. Anyone can bandage wounds and recover between skirmishes, with or without divine or arcane magic.
Goldshire is Elwynn Forest's main hamlet, just south of Stormwind City along the main trade road. It is a central hub for supplies and local trainers, with rest at the Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: Do I need prior training to complete this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Michelle Belle asks you to show your First Aid skill before she teaches you to make camp kits.

faq.q: How does a First Aid Kit fit into camping?
aliases: why make a first aid kit
faq.answer: A wilderness campsite offers a safe place to recover. A First Aid Kit keeps bandages and remedies close at hand, ready to save lives far from town healers.

angles.text: Goldshire is a crossroads for Alliance travelers heading from Northshire into Elwynn.
As a warrior, you have no healing spells of your own, so you rely on bandages and field kits to endure long campaigns in the wild.
As a rogue working in the shadows far from help, you depend on field medicine to bandage bleeding wounds before moving on to your next mark.
